For each `bats` group (including the NULL group), return `bats`, the number of appearance records, that count divided by the total count over all groups (including NULL), and that count divided by the average count per group (averaged over all groups including NULL). Don't round, sort or limit.

Join `appearances` to `player` on `player_id` (inner join), and keep only players with a real batting hand. Drop players whose `bats` is an empty string and also those whose `bats` is NULL. For each remaining `bats` value, return `bats`, the number of appearance records, that count divided by the total count over the remaining groups, and that count divided by the average count per remaining group. Don't round, sort or limit.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.bats IS NULL OR p.bats <> ''
  GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       cnt,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share_of_total,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM g) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM g;

SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appearances a2 JOIN player p2 ON a2.player_id = p2.player_id WHERE p2.bats IS NOT NULL AND p2.bats != '') AS ratio_total, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appearances a3 JOIN player p3 ON a3.player_id = p3.player_id WHERE p3.bats IS NOT NULL AND p3.bats != '') * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p4.bats) FROM appearances a4 JOIN player p4 ON a4.player_id = p4.player_id WHERE p4.bats IS NOT NULL AND p4.bats != '')) AS ratio_avg
FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats != ''
GROUP BY bats
